scriptedVariables.name: sfEventType
scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};const raw=String(read('eventType','event_type','type','action','operation','event.reason')||'').toLowerCase();if(raw.includes('move')||raw.includes('transfer')||raw==='employee.moved')return 'employee.moved';if(raw.includes('update')||raw==='change'||raw==='employee.updated')return 'employee.moved';return raw;
